ocr.markdown:
RECIPE FOR Spicy Mexican Party Dip
Mix:
1 lg. can beans dip        1-8oz sour cream
1/2 pkg taco seasoning    10 drops Tabasco
1-8oz pkg cream cheese    Diced onion to taste
Spread Monterey Jack cheese on top.
Bake @ 300° until bubbly.
Serve with taco or potato chips.
